'''Aztubek''' was a wealthy but little-developed [[Planet/Legends|planet]] lying along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] in the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was originally one of the eleven member worlds of [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]] prior to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] intervention, which reshaped the region's power structure. Aztubek became home to many corporate complexes, catering to workers who commuted from neighboring [[Javin]], the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]].

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Aztubek was the namesake of the [[Aztubek system/Legends|Aztubek system]]. It was located in the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]], part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion<ref name="Atlas" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and sat along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] just Rimward of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Javin]]. Aztubek's surface featured [[Water/Legends|snowy]], [[Forest/Legends|forested]] valleys.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==History==
Aztubek occupied what the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] originally considered to be [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], an imperfectly surveyed frontier region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that attracted only [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and the most daring [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. Specifically, Aztubek fell within [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]], a semi-independent grouping of eleven [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] ruled for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who were wary of the Republic.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Some thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Republic traders set out from the terminus of the Corellian Trade Spine at the planet Javin to reach the outer Mugaari worlds of Aztubek, [[High Chunah]], and beyond. They sought to establish contact with the [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]] and [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiins]], two other [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species ripe for trade, but these civilizations could not be reached without surrendering major profit shares to the Mugaari. The Republic eventually defeated the Mugaari in a brief, one-sided [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] to establish the Javin sector where Mugaari Space had been, and the Greater Javin exploded into an economic powerhouse.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

As the Rimward neighbor of Javin, the sector's governmental hub, Aztubek attracted corporate establishment. Although wealthy, the planet remained sparsely developed by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Inhabitants==
Corporate complexes dotted Aztubek's forest valleys,<ref name="Atlas" /> but few people took up permanent residence on the planet. Most workers [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttled]] in from neighboring Javin on [[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long rotations. Aztubek was originally one of eleven worlds inhabited by the Mugaari, whose regional influence waned following the arrival of the Republic.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aztubek was created for "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a [[2004]] [[Wizards.com|online]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', published in [[2009]], further developed Aztubek's [[Canon|lore]].<ref name="Atlas" />
